rules: Capability is date/platform specific and may be class-specific or experimental.
Computer access does not equal omniscience; databases contain only stored/authorized knowledge.
Replicator rules defer to resource/pattern/access constraints.
Holodeck simulation does not rewrite World State unless a real action leaves the simulation.
Holographic characters/agents that qualify as persistent persons use explicit identity/lifecycle rules rather than disposable dialogue generation.
AI interface is not automatically an in-universe sentient computer.
